injured_or_deformed: Exclude from rendering training by default.
reference_exception: Retain only when uniquely useful anatomy is documented and unavailable in other images; reference-only, not a rendering-training example.
uncertain_body_condition: Hold out of rendering training pending review; do not infer injury solely from posture or color.
severe_hand_occlusion: Reject when the visible anatomy adds little beyond clearer available images.
training_gate: Explicit accepted status, no rendering exclusion, no reference-only exception, and no rejected/supplemental suitability category. Missing review status is not acceptance.
original_files: Preserve original files, source labels, attribution, and review history. Rejection is exclusion, not deletion.
